body.title: Worker: lease rules replace recoverDeadLease
body.summary: Remove recoverDeadLease from the worker's tick and add the lease rules: for a lease that is not this claim's whose holder pid is gone, a same-windowKey lease whose CLI is alive is reclaim()ed and one whose CLI is gone is takeOver()n at once; another window's lease is takeOver()n only after LEASE_TAKEOVER_MS, passing a holderGone predicate built from deps.isAlive over the holder pid and the lease's CLI. Move the 97df9bf7 'worker recovery' test onto the new calls.
acceptanceChecks: a reloaded window (same key, new pid) with the old CLI alive reclaims the lease and the message is not failed
a reloaded window with the old CLI gone frees the lease at once and fails the message with a resend
another window's dead lease is freed only after LEASE_TAKEOVER_MS, and a heartbeating holder past LEASE_TAKEOVER_MS is never taken
a tick in a window running its own message does not touch the lease
the 97df9bf7 worker recovery test passes on the new calls

tests.name: chat-queue-worker.test.ts: worker recovery: a reloaded window reclaims a lease whose CLI lives and does not fail the message
chat-queue-worker.test.ts: worker recovery: a dead holder and dead CLI of another window is freed only after LEASE_TAKEOVER_MS and the next message runs
chat-queue-worker.test.ts: worker recovery: a holder that keeps heartbeating past LEASE_TAKEOVER_MS is never taken over
